title: Solar Photovoltaic System Fault Classification via Hierarchical Deep Learning with Imbalanced Multi-Class Thermal Dataset
mechanism: Two-stage hierarchy (normal vs fault, then fault type) plus contrast-preserving MixUp for low-contrast, imbalanced thermal crops.
evidence: R: 8-class thermal benchmark, 9 networks; Swin-T acc 89.48 %, F1 80.50; SlantNet 86.15 % acc at 42,072 img/s; ablations show minority-class gains.
adaptation: For EL: an image-level crack / inactive presence gate that multiplies pixel logits at inference, to cut false alarms on clean E1 cells (scuff); for thermal: the ISM recipe.
min_experiment: Arm PF + image-level crack / inactive head gating pixel logits; baseline PF; metrics E1 crack relP@2 at fixed relR@2, test relF1@2; kill if E1 relP@2 gain < 0.03.
prior_overlap: none. Multi-label / image-level heads never tried (BRIEF 5).
